findings.title: Silence action is a no-op for Prometheus-backed Grafana rules
findings.body: The new list items pass `promRule` without a `rulerRule`, so the menu can show Silence based on the Prometheus rule's abilities. Clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer`, but this condition only renders the drawer when `rule` is a Grafana ruler alerting rule. In the new list view that condition is false, leaving the visible Silence action with no effect.

findings.title: Delete action disappears when the list no longer loads ruler rules
findings.body: The new Grafana list items provide `promRule` but no `rulerRule`. Although `canDelete` can now be determined from the Prometheus rule, this render guard still requires `rulerRule`, so Grafana rules in the list have no Delete menu item. The list-view refactor therefore removes a previously available action for users with delete permission.

findings.title: Pause action disappears for Grafana rules in the new list view
findings.body: The new list items provide no `rulerRule`, so this condition is false even when `canPause` is granted using `promRule`. Consequently, the list view no longer offers Pause/Resume for Grafana-managed alert rules, despite calculating the corresponding ability.

findings.title: Grafana filtered results omit their React key
findings.body: This branch renders `GrafanaRuleListItem` without the `key` computed for every result, unlike the datasource and unknown-rule branches. Filter results are rendered as siblings in a changing, paginated list; without stable keys React can reuse the wrong row component when results are appended or changed, and emits missing-key warnings.
